name: V1/state-only
description: STATE-ONLY when the closure root has changed (e.g. a later-arriving ancestor) but the state still matches. The 'closure has changed' case is what the spec calls STATE-ONLY.
rule: spec §6: STATE-ONLY = state matches but closure has changed
input_modification: Add a new record that grows the closure of task-c without changing any state value (e.g. a new witness that sets a value already set).
